Delete Your Account

We're sorry to see you go. Account deletion on AbhiHub is a manual process handled by our admin team. To request deletion, send an email to us at the address below.

⚠️ Before You Delete
  • All your uploaded files and contributions will be permanently removed
  • Your reputation points and leaderboard ranking will be lost
  • You will lose access to all bookmarks and saved resources
  • This action cannot be undone
1
Send an email to codebymario@gmail.com with subject: "Account Deletion Request"
2
Include your registered email address and the reason for deletion (optional)
3
Our team will verify your identity and process the request. This may take several days to a month as this is a fully manual process
4
You'll receive a confirmation email once your account has been deleted
Send deletion request to
